sections.heading: The mistake
sections.content: People often assume feedback belongs in formal performance cycles—such as reviews every six months—and don’t think about or value it enough. Zhuo says feedback should ideally be a daily practice so teams can keep improving quickly. She also advises establishing an open-feedback relationship early, rather than waiting until something bad happens, when the conversation is already pressurized.
